IGUI_WaterPipes_SoundEnabled_tooltip: Looping ambient hum played by working machines, such as the electric purifier while it is powered. Turn off for total silence.
IGUI_WaterPipes_SoundVolume_tooltip: Volume of the mod's machine sounds, from 0 (silent) to 100 (loudest).
IGUI_WaterPipesPressureModelOff: Pressure is switched off in this game's sandbox options.
IGUI_WaterPipesGaugeSprinklerLow: Not enough for a sprinkler (needs %1). Add a pump.
IGUI_WaterPipesGaugeDripRisk: Too much for a drip emitter (bursts above %1). Put a router in between and set a limit.
IGUI_WaterPipesDripBurst: Blown out by too much pressure. It still carries water, but it has stopped watering.
IGUI_WaterPipesRouterPressureHint: Cap the pressure this router passes downstream:
